summary: Iteration 11: Validated new Substitution features — grouped ordering (backend + UI + print rowSpan), 3-file import (teachers_pdf + general_pdf + timing), Settings page (school_name, 8 period_times, timing image URL, no timing_data leak), timing-file public endpoint, /auth/account (wrong pwd 400, username change+restore, no-change 400), and 3 themes (light/dark/lux) with localStorage persistence + LuxParticles canvas. Backend pytest: 14/14 pass. Frontend UI: all critical assertions pass — theme switch on login and header, dark class + data-theme + html.sub-app-dark, reload persistence, lux canvas render, Settings page renders account/theme/timing cards with correct pre-filled values (username=ehtiyat, P1=7:25-8:05, P8=1:00-1:40), timing preview shown, save-then-reload persists 7:30 and restore worked, wrong current password shows Arabic error toast, /substitution auto-distribute produces two group header rows with 'المعلم الغائب: ' + count badge, no 'المعلم الغائب' column in data thead, copy button non-crashing, /substitution/print/2026-09-20 shows rowspan=2 and rowspan=4 cells with the two absent teachers' names.
critical_code_review_comments: substitution.py is 684 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap. Consider extracting settings/import/export helpers into modules for maintainability.
save_timing_file for PDFs parses text with parse_timing_text; if parse fails it silently returns detected=[] — acceptable but consider surfacing the error to UI.

read_pdf inside teachers_pdf import writes temp file under backend/data and unlinks — safe. However, when parse fails the message says 'aSc Timetables' which is specific; consider generic phrasing for general_pdf failures.
get_settings on first call inserts default doc including timing_data (b64) — good for seed. On subsequent PUT it always calls get_settings() first to ensure doc exists — safe idempotent behavior.
enrich_day sorts assignments by (absent-order, period) → grouped ordering is stable and reflects PUT /absent reordering (confirmed by test). Excellent.
DOCX export merges the absent-name column via python-docx cell merge for consecutive rows of same absent teacher; vMerge tokens confirmed present in generated XML.
settings/timing-file endpoint is public (no auth) — appropriate for embedding as . If leaking the image is a concern, gate via token; current behavior matches spec.

SubSettings.jsx TimingCard: 'save' handler passes period_times full array including any keystroke change → backend accepts trimmed strings; time format validation is minimal (frontend trusts free-form). Consider input mask like HH:MM.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned day 2026-09-20 (delete via API). Uploaded and restored school_timing.jpeg. Final state verified: username=ehtiyat, password=ehtiyat2026, school_name='مدرسة الخيرات للبنين ٥-٨', P1=7:25-8:05, timing image size=359772 bytes (original school_timing.jpeg).

Import modal UI (/substitution/teachers → sub-import-btn) was NOT clicked in browser (backend already covers 3-file import contract exhaustively in pytest — total=49, sources includes both, non-PDF general→400, no files→400, general-only preserves subjects).
